headline: Number 39: Utopia
title: Number 39: Utopia Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Number 39: Utopia. What is it? It is a Rank four LIGHT Warrior Xyz Monster with two thousand five hundred attack. What does it do? When a monster declares an attack, you can detach one material to negate the attack. Careful: if it is targeted for an attack with no material, it is destroyed. How do you use it? Xyz Summon it with two Level four monsters. It is in Duelist Pack: Yuma. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
